description:
Replace one fenced block's body source-preservingly — the surrounding fences, language tag, and neighbouring content are untouched. Locate the block by `blockId` or `index`. `language` acts as a guard: if the located block is not of the declared language, the update fails. `source` is the replacement body WITHOUT the surrounding ``` fences. Idempotent — re-running with identical inputs is a no-op on the file contents. Destructive — overwrites the previous block body in place.

Operates on the session-active vault (see `vault.current` — selectable via `vault.select`) unless an explicit `vaultPath` argument is passed, which always wins.

Examples:

Example 1 — Replace the first Mermaid diagram in a note:
```json
{
  "filePath": "Diagrams/system-overview.md",
  "language": "mermaid",
  "index": 0,
  "source": "flowchart TD\n  A --> B"
}
```

Example 2 — Update a DQL query block by stable id:
```json
{
  "filePath": "Dashboards/Inbox.md",
  "language": "dataview",
  "blockId": "inbox-open",
  "source": "TASK\nFROM #inbox\nWHERE !completed"
}
```

blockId.description: Stable block identifier (e.g. `^abc123`). Takes precedence over `index` when both are given.

filePath.description: Path of the note containing the block.

index.description: 0-based position of the block within its language group in the file. Use when no blockId is available. Defaults to 0 (the first block).

language.description: Language of the block being updated. Acts as a guard: update fails if the targeted block's real language does not match.

source.description: Replacement source for the block body, WITHOUT the surrounding ``` fences. Surrounding newlines and indentation are preserved by the tool.

name: blocks.update

outputSchema.description: Standard mutation envelope. Individual tools may attach additional fields (e.g. `created`, `appended`, `before`/`after` counts) — those are documented in the tool description.

changed.description: True if the tool altered vault state on this call; false if it was a no-op.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of what happened.

target.description: The path or identifier the tool acted on.

title: Update Fenced Block
